title: WARRANT overlay
description: Overlay — a policy layer applied when its `match` agrees with the classification of a Change (05 section 4).

id.description: Overlay id, unique across the packs enabled in a project.

overrides.description: Pack object this local overlay replaces, as `<pack>:<id>` (08 section 4).

description.description: What this overlay adds, in one sentence.

match.description: Classification fields that must agree for this overlay to apply. An empty object makes the overlay unconditional.

risk_level.description: Risk levels this overlay applies to.

profiles.description: Profile ids this overlay applies to; the match is an intersection.

data_loss.description: Values of the `data_loss` dimension this overlay applies to.

reversibility.description: Values of the `reversibility` dimension this overlay applies to.

blast_radius.description: Values of the `blast_radius` dimension this overlay applies to.

security_impact.description: Values of the `security_impact` dimension this overlay applies to.

compatibility.description: Values of the `compatibility` dimension this overlay applies to.

artifacts.description: Artifact requirements contributed by this overlay.

gates.description: Gates required per transition under this overlay.

capabilities.description: Capability restrictions contributed by this overlay.

approvals.description: Human approvals required under this overlay.

evidence.description: Evidence requirements contributed by this overlay.
